register.title: Register
register.displayNameHint: The name other members see in the history. Up to 100 characters.
register.passwordShort: The password must have at least 8 characters.
register.emailInUse: This e-mail address is already registered.

verify.body: We sent the confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it, then reload this page.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account. We will send you a link for a new password.
reset.sentBody: If the address is registered, we have sent it a link to reset the password.

groups.title: My groups
groups.intro: The groups you are a member of, with your role.
groups.emptyBody: A group keeps the contacts of one project or company in one place. You can also invite others to it.

account.title: My account
account.deleteIntro: Your account and all your memberships will be deleted. The contacts you created stay in the groups; your name stays in the history.
account.confirmBody: This cannot be undone. You will lose access to all your groups.
account.soleOwnerHint: Hand the owner role to another member or delete the group, then try again.

groupTrash.title: Group trash
groupTrash.intro: Deleted groups of which you are an owner. After 30 days they are deleted permanently with all their contacts.
groupTrash.nameTakenHint: Rename or delete the existing group, then try again.
groupTrash.emptyBody: Deleted groups stay here for 30 days.

deleteGroup.title: Delete group {{name}}?
deleteGroup.body: The group and all its contacts stay in the group trash for 30 days, where you can restore it. Then it is deleted permanently. It is hidden from its members at once.
deleteGroup.nameLabel: Type the group name to confirm
deleteGroup.done: The group is in the group trash.

trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Contacts in the trash are deleted permanently after 30 days. Until then you can restore them.
trash.foreverBody: This cannot be undone. The contact, its attributes and versions will be deleted. Only a record of the deletion stays in the history.
trash.emptyBody: Deleted contacts stay here for 30 days.
trash.noPermission: You do not have permission to open the trash. Viewers cannot.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.hint: The invited person gets access after signing in with this e-mail address. We send no message, so tell them yourself. The invitation is valid for 14 days.
invitations.created: Invitation created. Tell the invited person.
invitations.cancelBody: {{email}} will not get access with this invitation.
invitations.emptyBody: Invite a person with the form above.
invitations.noPermission: You may not manage invitations. Only owners can invite.

members.title: Members
members.removeBody: The member loses access to the group. Contacts and history entries the member created stay.

tags.title: Tags
tags.intro: The Tags of this Group and the number of Contacts with each. Add new Tags on a Contact.
tags.newNameHint: Letters, digits, - and _, up to 50 characters.
tags.deleteBody: {{contacts}} carry the tag. It will be removed from all of them; the contacts stay.
tags.emptyTitle: This group has no tags yet
tags.emptyBody: Add tags on a contact. They help you sort and filter contacts.
tags.noPermission: You do not have permission to manage tags.

error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.notFoundBody: The page does not exist or you do not have access to it.

request.unknown_property: The request contains an unknown field.

auth.token_invalid: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
auth.role_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.

group.name_taken: You already have a group with this name.
group.last_owner: A group needs at least one owner.
group.name_mismatch: The typed name does not match the group name.

contact.changed_by_someone_else: This contact was changed by someone else.
contact.in_trash: The contact is in the trash and cannot be changed.

tag.name_taken: A tag with this name already exists.

invitation.exists: This person is already a member or has a pending invitation.
invitation.limit: The group already has 20 pending invitations.

user.email_taken: This e-mail address already belongs to another account.

account.sole_owner: Your account cannot be deleted because you are the only owner of a group.

validation.required_any: Fill in at least first name, last name, e-mail or company.
validation.email_invalid: The e-mail address is not valid.
validation.phone_invalid: The phone number may contain digits, spaces and + - ( ) . /.
validation.country_invalid: The country is not on the list.
validation.attribute_key_invalid: The attribute key must have 1 to 50 characters.
validation.attribute_value_invalid: The attribute value must have 1 to 255 characters.
validation.attribute_duplicate_key: The attribute key is used twice.
validation.attribute_limit: A contact can have at most 50 attributes.
validation.tag_invalid: A tag name may contain letters, digits, - and _ (up to 50 characters).
validation.tag_limit: A contact can have at most 50 tags.
validation.name_invalid: The name must have 1 to 100 characters.

export.too_many: The selection has more than 10,000 contacts. Narrow it down.

activity.range_invalid: The start date is after the end date.

merge.invalid_selection: Choose at least two contacts of the same group to merge.
merge.invalid_value: The chosen value is not a value of the merged contacts.

rate.limited: Too many requests. Try again in a minute.

server.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

contacts.noTags: This contact has no tags yet.
contacts.noAttributes: This contact has no attributes yet.
contacts.attributeLimit: A contact can have at most 50 attributes.
contacts.deleteTitle: Move the contact to the trash?
contacts.deleteBody: The contact stays in the trash for 30 days, where you can restore it. Then it is deleted permanently.
contacts.movedToTrash: The contact is in the trash.
contacts.oneOfFour: Fill in at least one of first name, last name, e-mail or company.
contacts.fixFields: Correct the marked fields. The values you entered are kept.
contacts.conflictBody: The current contact is shown (version {{version}}). Your changes are not saved.

history.title: History
history.empty: This contact has no history yet.

contactList.title: Contacts
contactList.emptyTitle: This Group has no Contacts yet
contactList.emptyBody: A Contact is a person or an organisation you keep in the Group.
contactList.searchHint: Name, e-mail, company, city, Tag or Attribute value
contactList.noMatchBody: Change the search or the filters.

filters.title: Filters
filters.offered: Only the Tags, companies, countries and keys of this Group are offered.

activity.title: Group activity
activity.intro: All History entries of this group, newest first.
activity.noPermission: You do not have permission to see the group activity. Only Owners and Editors may.
activity.range: The start date is after the end date.
